historical_claims.version_difference: Successive registration of the five external geometric/GW inputs, not distinct theorem statements.

hypotheses: B smooth connected projective over C; E arbitrary algebraic rank at least two; no positivity or dual-global-generation assumption.
Lines convention, X=P_B(E), W=P_B(E plus O), torus weights 0 and 1, lambda inverted.
Actual effective integral H_2 labels (beta,l), with negative l retained when effective.
Positive degree from an integral ample p+M*pi^*H on W; full complex super cohomology and manuscript ancestor conventions.

assertions.statement: For P=X,W the map d -> (pi_*d,<c1(O_P(1)),d>) is an integral H_2 isomorphism, including torsion; inclusions and gluing preserve/add these labels.
assertions.decisive_argument: The global tautological class pairs to one with the fiber generator, forcing survival and splitting the degree-two edge sequence.
assertions.attribution: Manuscript geo:curve-labels and old report Section 6; no new result here.

assertions.statement: Effective integral labels and their decompositions are finite at bounded ample degree; graph and ancestor bounds define rational coefficient expansions and both filtered upper actions.
assertions.attribution: Old report Section 6; normalized nonnegative-l version also in manuscript Sections 3-4.

assertions.statement: Unique positive-filtration u_B,u_X and upper symplectic R simultaneously factor S_W and the ancestor potential for arbitrary E in the actual-effective-integral ample completion, allowing negative l.
assertions.decisive_argument: Orbit-cover geometry, compatible normalization, moment transport and graph stabilization use no positivity; replace l>=0 bookkeeping by positive ample degree.
assertions.attribution: Proposed strengthening in the existing Argus verification theorem, not a claim that the normalized manuscript master space is unchanged by twisting.

failed_approach.reason: An isomorphism P(E tensor L)=P(E) does not identify P(E tensor L plus O) with P(E plus O).

external_input_reference: Current OLD_LOC assumptions and research/literature/source_assessment.md; the extension reuses that geometry rather than acquiring a separate compiler proof.
evidence_limits: No formalization of integral homology, effective monoids, virtual geometry or arbitrary-E factorization.
The degree-one B=point replay cannot test torsion, base labels, negative tautological degrees or nonsplit bundles.
Effective l>=0 in the normalized manuscript is not asserted for arbitrary untwisted E.
The extension is not logically established merely by the normalized theorem plus an identification of projectivizations.

remaining_obligations.statement: Check the integral splitting, bounded-effective-label argument and reapplication of common-R geometry in the original arbitrary-E master space.
Retain the precise geometric/common-R and external-input conditions assessed in the localization unit; do not promote finite algebra to their proof.
